newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares surge, helped by OMV results.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares surge, helped by OMV results.

text.p: Austria's ATX blue-chip index surged on Tuesday to close nearly three percent higher but traders said the market remained nervous after recent sharp falls and was likely to be volatile over the next days.
However, robust earnings from industrial heavyweight OMV coupled with a 108-point rebound on Wall Street overnight helped boost confidence and assuage fears of a short-term rise in interest rates.
* Leading gainer CA preferred shares, up 7.56 percent at 599 ATS and traders reported talk of switching into the stock from Bank Austria .
* Leading decliner fireproof materials maker Radex RHI.VI, down 0.56 percent, at 537 ATS.
* Oil and chemicals group OMV's shares jumped to end 6.42 percent stronger at 1,761.1 schillings after posting a 105 percent rise in half-year earnings (EBIT).
* September ATX futures end up 43 points at 1,395.
